law: GATE 1A.2 section 5: the run schedule is a FROZEN OBJECT. The expected receipt set is DERIVED from this signed manifest (the execution approval binds its sha256 as run_schedule_sha256); it is never hardcoded as a bare count. For each required (arm, seed) exactly one successful receipt is demanded; None, duplicate, missing, extra, failed, wrong-update-count, wrong-layer, wrong-checkpoint-digest, wrong-cache-digest, wrong-identity, and wrong-commit receipts are refused (exec/schedule.py).
seed_options_note: the code supports either 3 or 5 claim-bearing seeds; the OWNER decides (open decision); the execution approval binds exactly one frozen list, which must equal this manifest's claim_bearing_seeds at signing
